generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall have successfully carried out Supply & Installation/AMC of Online or Offline UPS System/Repair of UPS system in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said single work & work done of value not less than Rs.0.79 Lakhs in last preceding five financial years and shall furnish copy of the related work order/PO and corresponding Work done/work completion certificate/Installation report/supply completion report issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence.(Work done/work completion certificate/Installation report/supply completion report of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited)

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name shall have achieved in at least two financial years an average financial turnover of Rs. 1.58 Lakhs in the last preceding five years and furnish annual turnover certificate OR Profit & Loss statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
